detail.body:
# What does this PR do?

Add GB200 BF16 library recipes for Beam pretraining and full SFT on 64 GPUs, and LoRA on 32 GPUs, with related runtime fixes needed to train the released checkpoint.

# Changelog

- Use HybridEP within one NVLink domain: TP4/EP64 for 4K pretraining, TP8/EP64 for 8K packed SFT, and TP4/EP32 for 8K packed LoRA. Preserve natural routing and FP32 gradients, master parameters and Adam moments.
- Pretraining captures attention/router CUDA graphs and selectively recomputes expert activations to retain memory headroom. Packed finetuning stays eager without recompute. All three use periodic garbage collection; TP and fine-grained expert communication overlap remain disabled.
- Preserve FP32/FP64 router GEMMs under model autocast, execute gate bias through its parameter-owning module, include captured sandwich norms in parameter-gather ownership, and skip update collectives for fixed expert biases. Remove the obsolete distributed-optimizer constructor modification now covered by the pinned Megatron-Core.
- Use native Beam support from Transformers 5.20.1 and remove the local configuration fallback and registration. The lockfile upgrade and related compatibility fixes landed in #6531; this PR retains the `>=5.20.1,<5.21` package requirement needed for native Beam.
- Add recipe exports, focused regressions, a two-GPU graph/gather regression, usage examples and measured training results. H200 training settings are preserved; their checkpoint revision is updated to the publicly resolvable release. Extend the verification card and generated catalog with the three completed GB200 training runs at their tested Bridge commit. GB200 export/inference, long-context SFT and checkpoint resume remain unverified; refresh the commit and evidence after post-merge retesting.

# Validation

Retested after merging main `01d1c29ad769668dcadaae52896319afce56feb5` at PR head `aedba7f32e8f6bb43105e8710167ed08668ce4c8`. All three recipes completed a fresh 100-step full-model run using NeMo 26.10 RC5, native Beam support from Transformers 5.20.1, Megatron-Core `8442db193ced81584c2e94faa352ec7307d18d83`, and public Beam revision `06641076793dad51b8907f7eb2a14f4e08fd3ec8`. Transformers was installed as a no-dependency wheel overlay; Bridge and MCore used the pinned source, while the remaining image packages were retained. This does not claim a full installation of main's lockfile.

Each run starts from the same imported public checkpoint and retains the previously tested inputs, schedules, precision, natural routing and performance settings. Actual placement, effective configuration, optimizer state, model partitions and graph/recompute execution were checked on every rank. Checkpoint writes and evaluation are disabled.

| Recipe | GPUs | Steps | Seconds/update | Physical tokens/s/GPU | Model TFLOP/s/GPU | Minimum observed free memory |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Pretrain | 64 | 100 | 7.6850 | 2131.93 | 295.09 | 11.36 GiB |
| Full SFT | 64 | 100 | 1.6841 | 605.61 | 83.18 | 9.28 GiB |
| LoRA | 32 | 100 | 1.3313 | 1534.31 | 210.71, full-training equivalent | 87.90 GiB |

Throughput uses updates 51–100 and the slowest rank's synchronized elapsed time, including five periodic garbage collections and intervening logging. Token counts include padding. Model FLOPs are architecture-based estimates, not measured hardware FLOPs. The LoRA FLOP estimate uses the full-training formula; it is neither actual adapter compute nor MFU. All three runs passed 100 finite updates with zero skipped/NaN updates and at least 4 GiB observed memory headroom. First/last ten-update mean losses are 1.1828/1.0398 for pretraining, 1.0766/0.7390 for SFT, and 1.0778/0.8389 for LoRA. Full-checkpoint save/export/resume and adapter export are not established by these training runs.

The previous measurements in the recipe guide used Transformers 5.17 and the earlier configuration fallback. These fresh results validate the updated stack; one run per stack on different valid single-domain allocations does not establish a repeatable speedup. The earlier matched tuning screens remain the basis for configuration selection: router graphs without selective recompute failed the memory-margin check; TP2/PP2/EP32, activation fusion and TP overlap were rejected after their respective memory or numerical failures. SM16 and SM32 were effectively tied in the selected pretraining configuration; retained SM32 is not claimed to be superior.

- Focused RC5 CPU suite at the validated head above with Transformers 5.20.1: 679 passed, 27 CUDA-only skips. Covers native Beam construction/forward/config roundtrips, H200/GB200 recipes, shared AutoBridge/model bridge/conversion/HF wrapper paths, and relevant Transformers compatibility cases. That historical count includes six PEFT YAML tests subsequently removed with the out-of-scope serialization change.
- RC5 GPU checks at the validated head above: 223 Beam tests passed without skips, and two distributed graph/optimizer/gather tests passed on each of two ranks. CPU and GPU suites overlap and are not summed as distinct cases.
- Native CLI/config checks passed for all three documented commands. Strict full-run configuration checks also passed; altered routing, optimizer settings, missing updates, nonfinite values, insufficient headroom and unexpected graph/recompute behavior remain rejection cases.
- Generated-document consistency and all-files hooks passed in RC5. Independent review of the current-main integration, test evidence and each complete 100-step result found no blocker within the stated validation scope.

- Verification-card update: card validator, generated-output check, 24 documentation consistency tests and all-files formatting hooks pass. These documentation checks ran locally; no new recipe validation or performance run was launched. Card metrics follow the final-ten-step logger convention; the separate steps-51–100 measurements above include recurring garbage collection and logging. Historical H200 evidence is retained. The RC5 public base image is unconfirmed, so the card explicitly limits its existing base-container field to the historical runs.

# GitHub Actions CI

Current-head GitHub Actions results are reported on this PR. The RC5 results above were refreshed after merging the Transformers upgrade from main.

# Before your PR is ready for review

- [x] Followed the contributor guidelines.
- [x] Added focused regression tests and recipe checks.
- [x] Updated documentation and generated pages.
- [x] Transformers 5.20.1 lockfile upgrade landed in #6531; this PR retains the required package minimum.

# Additional Information

Builds on #6498. The Transformers 5.20.1 lockfile upgrade and related compatibility fixes landed in #6531, and #6530 was closed as superseded. This PR retains the package minimum required for native Beam support. Primary area: recipes. The PEFT serialization change and its six YAML round-trip tests have been removed from this PR. Standard `run_recipe.py` training passes the Python configuration directly and does not require that fix. The 100-step measurements above were collected before this removal; recipe settings and training fixes are unchanged, and those runs have not been repeated after removal.

+    tp, cp, pp = model.tensor_model_parallel_size, model.context_parallel_size, model.pipeline_model_parallel_size
+    ep, etp = model.expert_model_parallel_size, model.expert_tensor_parallel_size
+    assert world_size % (pp * math.lcm(tp * cp, ep * etp)) == 0
+    assert model.num_moe_experts % ep == 0
+    assert model.num_attention_heads % tp == model.num_query_groups % tp == 0
+    assert cfg.train.global_batch_size % (cfg.train.micro_batch_size * world_size // (tp * cp * pp)) == 0
+    assert cfg.model.hybrid_layer_pattern.count("*") == 52
